newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants sees restated '96 EPS $0.50-$0.70.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants sees restated '96 EPS $0.50-$0.70.

text.p: First Merchants Aceptance Corp said Thursday it estimates its restated net earnings for 1996 will be $0.50 to $0.70 a share, versus the $1.56 originally reported.

Norman Smagley, chief financial officer, said the company was completing the restatement of its financial results for 1996 and finalizing results for the 1997 first quarter. The data are expected to be released by the end of June, he said.
"No one should rely on either the previously published 1996 financial statements or the related independent auditors' report," he said.
